name: Madeira. Tão tua
verdict: Destination brand of Madeira, published by the Madeira Promotion Bureau (Associação de Promoção da Madeira) and used by the Regional Government of Madeira. Nothing found.
note: Rating note (2026-10-03): the 'Madeira. Tão tua' brand's official site (madeirabelongstoall.com) is published by the Associação de Promoção da Madeira; TNews (2021-04-13) reports the brand is used by VisitMadeira and by the Regional Government of Madeira. On the Marítimo home shirt 2026-27 (upper front) and at Nacional (back) in 2026-27. Portugal/Madeira has no sourced record of serious abuses in this data, so state-region ownership alone is 'none' (METHOD.md).
